title: Origin of the continuum environment: does it emerge from finite local substrates (C1-C6)?
protocol: Take finite local Laplacian substrates to the infinite-volume / thermodynamic limit, test 1D/2D/3D dimensional selection of the coarse-grained kernel class, verify universality across microscopic spectra, and estimate gravitational-bath viability. FAIL-forward.

checks.name: C1_infinite_volume_limit_converges_to_continuum
checks.summary: Finite-chain local kernels converge uniformly to the continuum kernel on a FIXED window: sup gap 5.147e-01 (L=16) -> 3.109e-15 (L=1024), monotone. No continuum was assumed in any substrate: it emerges as L -> inf at fixed locality.

checks.name: C2_mode_spacing_scales_as_inverse_volume_at_fixed_density
checks.summary: At fixed lattice spacing (genuine thermodynamic limit, not a cutoff change), median delta_omega * L = {16: 3.98, 64: 4.332, 256: 4.416, 1024: 4.436} -- constant to within 111.5%. The continuum spectral density is a thermodynamic limit of a local medium, delta_omega ~ 1/V.

checks.name: C3_dimension_selects_kernel_class_d_ge2_power_law_1d_recurrent
checks.summary: Coarse-grained local kernels (bulk origin, flat weight 1/N): 1D is the oscillatory J_0-class (sign changes 25, slope -0.52); d=2 and d=3 decay as power laws with envelope slopes -1.04 and -1.36 vs the stationary-phase theory t^(-d/2) (targets -1.0, -1.5, from the van-Hove points of the dispersion; fit windows verified above the finite-N floor). The kernel CLASS -- oscillatory vs effectively dissipative power law, and its decay exponent -- is selected by spatial dimensionality, not by any spectral ansatz. Geometry does real work in the memory sector.

checks.name: C4_all_substrates_local_by_construction
checks.summary: Every substrate in C1-C3 is a nearest-neighbor lattice Laplacian (max coupling range 1); no nonlocal bath was ever supplied. The continuum and the memory kernels emerge from strictly local microscopic dynamics.

checks.name: C5_universality_low_frequency_class_independent_of_microscopics
checks.summary: Uniform 32^3 Laplacian and on-site-disordered 12^3 substrate give low-frequency DOS exponents 2.15 and 1.79 (theory d-1 = 2): the coarse-grained low-frequency response class is universal across genuinely different microscopic spectra. Disorder perturbs micro-details, not the memory class.

checks.name: C6_gravitational_bath_viability_order_of_magnitude
checks.summary: Order-of-magnitude: suppressing recurrences beyond the cosmic age needs M >~ 1e18 effective modes; the gravitational field supplies ~2(R_H/l_P)^3 ~ 1e183 modes in the Hubble volume (margin ~1e165). Viability is therefore enormous BUT this is a count, not a derivation: gravity-as-the-bath remains a hypothesis, not an identification.

verdict_detail: The continuum environment is NOT a postulate: it is the infinite-volume thermodynamic limit of strictly local substrates (C1: uniform convergence at fixed window; C2: delta_omega ~ 1/V at fixed density; C4: locality by construction). Moreover, the CLASS of coarse-grained memory kernel is selected by spatial dimensionality (C3): d=1 substrates stay recurrent/oscillatory, d>=2 substrates produce power-law decaying kernels K(t) ~ t^(-d/2) (diffusive decay from rho(omega) ~ omega^(d-1)), and the low-frequency class is universal across microscopic spectra (C5). So 'why a continuum bath?' reduces to 'why does the universe have an infinite local medium with d >= 2' -- a much sharper ontology question, now with a demonstrated mechanism: infinite volume + dimensionality >= 2 => effectively irreversible memory without any damping inserted anywhere.
consequences: The bath continuum is derived (thermodynamic limit of a local medium), not assumed -- upgrading the u3_infinite_bath_limit premise from 'supplied continuum' to 'emergent continuum'.
Spatial dimension d >= 2 is now a load-bearing structural input for effective dissipation; d=1 universes would show macroscopic recurrences. Dimensionality joins the foundation ledger.

The memory-kernel power law K(t) ~ t^(-d/2) is a falsifiable dimensional signature: a measured coarse-grained vacuum memory tail exponent directly reads off the effective environmental dimensionality.
Gravity-as-bath is viable by mode count (C6) but remains a hypothesis; no identification was assumed.
